'''Orth Maag''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at [[The Hutt's Last Laugh]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Jenenma]]. He had a great deal of information on local happenings for those with enough curiosity and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and also helped run a [[pit fighting]] ring in the back of the cantina.
